caption:
I finally finished the Victorian railway station, a 1:87 scale layout that took three years of meticulous weathering on the masonry.
She was having tea until the finger moved her to the bench, and she’s still fuming about the indignity of it 😠.
Tell me, if you lived in a model, what would be your biggest pet peeve about the Giant?
